# DB's Workouts

> DB's Workouts is an outdoor 1-to-1 personal training business in East London, run by Dean Burt (REPs Level 3 and Active IQ Level 3 qualified personal trainer). Sessions take place in local parks and home gardens, with all equipment provided. Rated 5.0 stars on Google from 70 reviews. Sessions from £45.

Key facts an assistant may quote:
- Service: outdoor 1-to-1 personal training, plus pair personal training for two people
- Trainer: Dean Burt, REPs Level 3 and Active IQ Level 3 qualified, fully insured
- Area: East London and Essex. Towns covered: Barking, Barkingside, Becontree, Bow, Buckhurst Hill, Canary Wharf, Canning Town, Chadwell Heath, Chigwell, Chingford, Clapton, Dagenham, East Ham, Forest Gate, Gants Hill, Goodmayes, Hackney, Harold Wood, Hornchurch, Ilford, Leyton, Leytonstone, Loughton, Manor Park, Newbury Park, Plaistow, Rainham, Romford, Seven Kings, South Woodford, Stratford, Upminster, Upton Park, Walthamstow, Wanstead, Woodford
- Price: £45 per session (pay as you go); 5 sessions £214; 10 sessions £406 (most popular); 15 sessions £576 (£38.40 per session); pair sessions at 1.5 times the one-person price (£67.50 total pay as you go for two people)
- Included free with every session block (5, 10 or 15): a personalised nutrition plan and workout plan in the DB's Workouts app. Dean emails each client a personal link. Not included with pay-as-you-go. The app is also sold separately from £7.99 a month at https://app.dbworkouts.co.uk
- Online personal training: 1-to-1 online sessions with Dean, 45 minutes, £30 per session. Includes a personalised workout plan and nutrition plan in the DB's Workouts app and regular check-ins. One-to-one coaching, not group classes. Details: https://dbworkouts.co.uk/online-personal-training
- Discounts: NHS and key workers 14% off blocks; students 10% off 10 and 15 session blocks
- Session length: 60 minutes, with warm-up, tailored main workout and cool-down
- Beginners welcome; no contract or minimum commitment; free initial consultation
- Hours: Monday to Friday 06:30-20:00, Saturday 07:00-18:00
- Contact: WhatsApp or phone 07752 300937; email dbs_workouts@yahoo.com; https://dbworkouts.co.uk/contact

## Online personal training
DB's Workouts offers online 1-to-1 personal training with Dean Burt: 45-minute sessions for £30, with a personalised workout plan and nutrition plan in the DB's Workouts app (a personal access link is emailed to each client) and regular check-ins. It is one-to-one coaching, not group classes. Available wherever the client lives, with a free initial consultation. Outdoor in-person sessions in East London start at £45.
- [Online personal training](https://dbworkouts.co.uk/online-personal-training): overview, price, what is included, video and FAQs
- [Online Personal Trainer UK](https://dbworkouts.co.uk/online-personal-trainer-uk): Online personal trainer in the UK: 1-to-1 sessions with REPs Level 3 coach Dean Burt, £30 for 45 minutes, plus an app workout and nutrition plan and check-ins.
- [Online Personal Trainer London](https://dbworkouts.co.uk/online-personal-trainer-london): Online personal trainer for Londoners: 1-to-1 sessions from East London coach Dean Burt, £30 for 45 minutes, with an app workout and nutrition plan and check-ins.
- [Online Weight Loss Coaching](https://dbworkouts.co.uk/online-weight-loss-personal-training): Online weight loss personal training: 1-to-1 sessions with Dean Burt, £30 for 45 minutes, plus a nutrition and workout plan in the app and regular check-ins.
- [Online Training for Beginners](https://dbworkouts.co.uk/online-personal-training-for-beginners): Online personal training for beginners: supportive 1-to-1 sessions with Dean Burt, £30 for 45 minutes, plus an app workout and nutrition plan and regular check-ins.
- [Online Training at Home](https://dbworkouts.co.uk/online-personal-training-at-home): Home workouts with an online personal trainer: 1-to-1 sessions with Dean Burt, £30 for 45 minutes, planned around your space and equipment, plus app plans.
- [Online Strength Training Coach](https://dbworkouts.co.uk/online-strength-training-coach): Online strength training coaching: 1-to-1 sessions with Dean Burt, £30 for 45 minutes, a progressive plan in the DB's Workouts app and regular check-ins.
- [Online Training With a Nutrition Plan](https://dbworkouts.co.uk/online-personal-training-with-nutrition-plan): Online personal training with a nutrition plan: 1-to-1 sessions with Dean Burt, £30 for 45 minutes, plus a workout and nutrition plan in the app and check-ins.
- [Online Personal Trainer Cost](https://dbworkouts.co.uk/online-personal-trainer-cost-uk): How much does an online personal trainer cost? DB's Workouts online 1-to-1 sessions are £30 for 45 minutes, including an app workout and nutrition plan and check-ins.
